title: Valley View Cottage, 22 miles from Nashville
description:
Take it easy at this unique & tranquil getaway log cabin with central air/heat & keyless entrance. No pets at all or smoking as we have allergies. The living room has a 55 in smart TV w/Roku, small fridge, microwave & keurig. It's a great place to work remote. The Queen bedroom has a Smart TV & a desk. You have a covered parking space  & access to the main home front porch with a small table & 2 chairs, porch swing & rockers.

The space
This cottage is 800 sq ft. You walk up one step to the porch and through the front door. Then into the living/kitchenette area. To the right is the bedroom with a Smart TV , a small desk area & a walk in closet. Back out to the living/kitchenette area the bathroom is to the right. The hall goes to our private living quarters and yes the door stays locked.
Parking available for one vehicle only.

Guest access
We live in a small 3 street neighborhood. Speed is 20MPH. We are  located at the end of Valley View where the pavement ends. You have one covered parking space for one vehicle only. There is  a circle driveway which is easy to maneuver out.

Other things to note
My husband and I both work from home. Sometimes there will be cars here but you will always be able to get in and out of your space.
